name: openverse-backend
description: Firebase project tooling for OpenVerse: emulators, rules, indexes, deploys.

scripts.test:emulator: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-openverse --only auth,firestore,functions "npm --prefix functions run test:emulator"
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run test:emulator
scripts.emulators: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-openverse
scripts.emulators:persist: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-openverse --import ./emulator-data --export-on-exit ./emulator-data
